
```{devoirs_choices variance_8_one_choices}
- The squared counterpart to standard deviation for describing a distribution's spread.:
    correct: true
    feedback: Correct.
- A guarantee that all observations lie within a fixed distance of the mean.:
    correct: false
    feedback: Variance summarizes spread but does not set a hard bound on every observation.
- The parameter that makes all outcomes equally likely within an interval.:
    correct: false
    feedback: Equal likelihood within an interval describes a uniform distribution,
      not variance.
- A relative probability assigned to one possible outcome.:
    correct: false
    feedback: Relative probability describes an outcome's likelihood; variance summarizes
      distribution spread.
```

Only one of the following is a valid description of variance. Mark that one.

```{r}
devoirs3::devoirs_selection(

  multiple = FALSE
)()
```
